disclaimer: Environmental exposure/proxy indicators (0-100). NOT temperatures, NOT reservoir storage, NOT flood/water-supply probabilities.

heat.why_proxy: No temperature telemetry exists in the project. Score measures urban surface exposure (built-up vs vegetation) from real ESA WorldCover fractions - it is NOT measured heat.

water.why_proxy: No reservoir/storage/supply telemetry exists. Score compares recent 30-day rainfall against the zone's own prior-years climatology (leak-safe feature hist_mean_prior_years_mm x 30 from the frozen dataset). Meteorological drought signal ONLY.
water.missing_handling: 2015 rows have no prior-year baseline and the first 29 days lack a complete 30-day window -> score/level returned as null with explanation (never imputed)
water.interpretation_note: HIGH = strong meteorological deficit (dry spell vs own climatology), NOT empty reservoirs
